title: Run Settlement Export as a Job
description:
**SITUATION:**

Identity is ready. Finance now wants a **one-shot Job** that uses that ServiceAccount to list Payment Handler Pods (settlement inventory). The Job must not run as `default`.

This lab runs a one-shot **Job** under the settlement ServiceAccount from the previous lab. Default ServiceAccount is off-limits; prove the dedicated identity works end to end.
**YOUR TASK:**

1. Create a **Job** that uses `serviceAccountName: settlement-exporter`.
2. Verify the Job **Completes** successfully.

**SPEC:**

- Job name: `settlement-export`
- `serviceAccountName: settlement-exporter`
- Image: `bitnami/kubectl:latest` (or platform-provided kubectl image)
- Command example:  
  `["kubectl", "get", "pods", "-l", "app=payment-handler", "-o", "wide"]`
- Restart policy: `OnFailure` or `Never`
- Completions: `1`
- Job status: **Complete**

**CONSTRAINTS:**

- Manifest: `settlement-export-job-l17.yaml`.
- Do **not** recreate the SA/Role/RoleBinding unless missing — reuse the existing ones.
- Do **not** use the `default` ServiceAccount.
- Work only in your lab namespace (not `default`).

problemStatement.solution:
# Solution — Run Settlement Export as a Job

Stay in your lab namespace. Run a one-shot Job under ServiceAccount `settlement-exporter` (from the previous lab) to list Payment Handler Pods.

Docs: [Jobs](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/job/)

## Solution YAML

Save as `settlement-export-job-l17.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: settlement-export
spec:
  completions: 1
  template:
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: settlement-exporter
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
      containers:
        - name: exporter
          image: bitnami/kubectl:latest
          command: ["kubectl", "get", "pods", "-l", "app=payment-handler", "-o", "wide"]
```

## Declarative

```bash
kubectl apply -f settlement-export-job-l17.yaml
kubectl wait --for=condition=complete job/settlement-export --timeout=120s
kubectl get job settlement-export
```

Wait until the Job is **Complete**, then **Submit**. Do not use the `default` ServiceAccount.
